submissions.claim: Wrote the four peer-b HACP Secure design docs, consistent with peer a's accepted architecture (challenges 1-5, F1-F7). hacp-secure-threat-model.md: assets, adversaries ADV-1..6, standard vs degraded mode, 25 STRIDE threats each mapped to a named failure mode and test ID, confused deputy stated plainly, 7 invariants, challenge record. hacp-secure-modules.md: custody-by-module rules (agent binary links client+envelope only, no key material; non-serializable zeroizing secret types), module inventory incl. client.rs, exact agent CLI outputs, guardian socket allowlist (no sign/export), normative 9-stage receive pipeline, SecureError enum, proposed phase-2 contracts. hacp-secure-test-matrix.md: 45 tests across compatibility, key custody (canary scans), authentication, tampering, replay/gap/SequenceGap, contract binding, downgrade/fail-closed, and RFC/golden known-answer vectors, with requirement coverage R1-R8. hacp-secure-non-goals.md: 24 explicit non-goals incl. content safety, control-plane authenticity, TIER-2 not proving bilateral agreement, metadata confidentiality, PKI, revocation, post-compromise security, degraded-mode same-uid snooping. All 8 frozen acceptance commands pass locally.
